name: io.github.PiotrZapolski/booksy-mcp
title: Booksy Biz
description: Booksy Biz through your own logged-in browser tab. No session tokens leave the browser.

environmentVariables.name: BOOKSY_MCP_WRITE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated write tools to enable, or "all" for those that do not reach clients. Writes are off by default.

environmentVariables.name: BOOKSY_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port for the browser extension. Default 47821.

environmentVariables.name: BOOKSY_MCP_MASK_CONTACTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to mask client phone numbers and e-mails in tool output.
